messages:
Maria G: Hey team — ran into a parity bug between node/python SDKs. Node is retrying POSTs on transient 429s and doing an auth refresh concurrently which caused duplicate webhook deliveries. Logs: `request id=abc123 status=429, then 200 (duplicate)`
Kevin L: ugh. repro steps?
Maria G: Create resource, force 429 by throttling in test env, Node retried without Idempotency-Key. snippet:
```js
await client.createItem({ name: 'x' }) // SDK-level retry: maxRetries=5, exponential backoff
// we don't set Idempotency-Key anywhere
```
Sophie R: Python SDK sets `Idempotency-Key` for create/update methods by default (UUID per request). Node should mirror that.
Alex P: Also we have an auth refresh race: when token expired, Node does token refresh and replays the original request. Combined with retry on 429 you can get 2 replays.
Maria G: Exact. Observed flow: 401 -> token refresh -> replay, concurrently 429 retry -> duplicate POST.
Kevin L: Proposed fix: (1) make Node inject Idempotency-Key for mutating calls, (2) ensure token refresh returns a single blocker so in-flight requests wait for the refreshed token, (3) respect `Retry-After` and do conditional retries. Thoughts?
Sophie R: +1. Also recommend default retry config: maxRetries=3, base=100ms, maxDelay=2s, jitter=0.25. And for 429 if `Retry-After` present use that value.
Alex P: Agree. For SDK parity we should add a small opt-out for Idempotency-Key (some customers want to control it). Default on for create/update/delete.
CI Bot: test-run/update 1769802000: created integration test to simulate throttling and token refresh -> pending
Maria G: I'll update Node sample app (sample/drop-in) and add integration that asserts single create call at server side when both 401 and 429 occur.
Kevin L: For idempotency header name let's use `Idempotency-Key` (string UUID). align with python.
Sophie R: Also document behavior in SDK table: which methods auto-add idempotency, how to opt-out, how we handle 401+429 combos.
Alex P: I'll own the sample app PR. tagging @Sophie R for docs, @Maria G for tests. ETA EOW?
Maria G: EOW works. I'll open PR with tests + repro fixture.
Kevin L: nice. :thumbsup:
Alex P: assigning to @alexp in Github when PR goes up.
Maria G: thanks all — this should reduce duplicates in production.
